name: Spring double hit: a double jump in the spring's trigger takes a second hit
techNote: spring-clip's ledge (top y 0, x -120-0), ceiling (bottom y 340) and the Course 5 ceiling spring hanging from it pointing down (SpringScript upForce 70, strength 300, movementLock 0.25; trigger 80x80 at x 80-160, y 260-340, turned 180°), with the double jump unlocked (WJ_DS_DJ). A down spring hit sets Velocity.y -270 and adds momentum.y -575 (hitSpring 2474-2477) and refills the air jumps (2472). A double jump 2 ticks after the hit (Velocity.y set to airJumpForce, 745: 1768-1774) holds the dot against the -550 momentum: it hovers a few u a tick inside the trigger until SpringScript's 0.15 s cooldown ends (OnTriggerStay2D sets cooldown, Invoke endCooldown 0.15 s), and the spring hits again: momentum.y -1054.9. A double jump 3 or 4 ticks after the hit is too late (the dot has sunk out of the trigger), and a third hit fails (745 against about -1030 sinks out). A 32-tall spike strip (layer 6, spikeScript: x -1260-1140, y -98 to -66) under the ledge covers every way down and the finish box is under it: a spike kills on its 2nd OnTriggerStay2D (counter > graceFrames 1), so the 54-tall hurtbox has to cover 86 u in 3 ticks (28.67 a tick). One hit's fall is 25-27 u a tick at that depth and dies; the double hit's is 32 and gets through on 2 ticks.

ghosts.label: Same jump, no double jump: one hit
